draft.subject: Getting Cedar Group's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge issue — your ticket is still open with Tariq, and he'll follow up there shortly.

In the meantime, I'd like to help you get started. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so setting up your first project is the natural first step. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you.

Best,
Priya
